annotations.title: Domain trust verdict: age, DNS and email-auth flags

description: A trust verdict for any domain in one call: high/medium/low trust with named flags for very new registrations, expiry, missing or weak SPF and DMARC, too few nameservers, no web host and non-resolving domains, plus the key facts (registrar, age, nameservers, DNSSEC). Use for lead qualification, phishing and vendor checks, and before an agent sends mail to or trusts a domain. Signals only, not a guarantee. Raw DNS records: domain. Example: name=cloudflare.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
